key_catalyst: Mechanical Deleveraging and Margin Calls in Leveraged AI Trades
reasoning: All three open catalysts remain actively unresolved and escalating. The semiconductor bear market (SOX down 24-25%) shows no signs of stabilization, the leveraged AI trade is mechanically unwinding with record $1.5T margin debt and confirmed margin calls in South Korea, and multiple tech giants delivered disappointing guidance with key earnings still ahead this week. The intraday pattern of pre-market gains fading into session losses (July 15: -0.96%, July 16: -1.12%, July 20: -0.88%) confirms persistent selling pressure that has not been absorbed.
